cards.ex: I bent over backwards to help him, and he didn't even thank me.
cards.exUz: Men unga yordam berish uchun jon kuydirdim, lekin u hatto rahmat ham aytmadi.
cards.uzDef: Qattiq harakat qilmoq, juda ko'p urinmoq kimningdir uchun yoki nimadir uchun.

cards.ex: The company values employees who show initiative and can solve problems independently.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya tashabbus ko'rsata oladigan va muammolarni mustaqil hal qila oladigan xodimlarni qadrlaydi.
cards.uzDef: O'zidan yangi g'oyalar va harakatlar ko'rsatish, boshqalardan kutmasdan.

cards.ex: Her go-getting attitude impressed everyone on the team.
cards.exUz: Uning ishtiyoqli yondashuvi jamoaning barcha a'zolariga ta'sir qildi.
cards.uzDef: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun qattiq mehnat qilish va harakat qilish xususiyati.

cards.ex: He bit off more than he could chew by taking on three extra projects.
cards.exUz: U uchta qo'shimcha loyihani olib, uddalay olmaydigan ishlarni qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qobiliyatidan ortiq vazifani o'z zimmasiga olmoq, uddalay olmaslik.

cards.ex: While it's good to strive for perfection, it's also important to be realistic.
cards.exUz: Mukammallikka intilish yaxshi bo'lsa-da, real bo'lish ham muhim.
cards.uzDef: Har doim eng yuqori sifatga erishish uchun harakat qilish, xatolardan qochish.

cards.ex: If we all put our backs into it, we can finish the project on time.
cards.exUz: Agar hammamiz astoydil kirishsak, loyihani o'z vaqtida tugata olamiz.
cards.uzDef: Ishga butun kuchingiz bilan kirishmoq, qattiq mehnat qilmoq.

cards.ex: They pulled out all the stops to make sure the event was a success.
cards.exUz: Ular tadbirning muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishi uchun borini berishdi.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan maqsadga erishish uchun qo'lidan kelgan hamma narsani qilish.

cards.ex: You'll have your work cut out for you if you want to pass this exam.
cards.exUz: Agar siz ushbu imtihondan o'tmoqchi bo'lsangiz, ishingiz ko'p bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: O'ta qiyin yoki katta hajmdagi vazifani bajarish kerakligi.

cards.ex: She's driven by ambition to become a successful entrepreneur.
cards.exUz: U muvaffaqiyatli tadbirkor bo'lish ishtiyoqi bilan harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Katta maqsadlarga erishish istagi bilan harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: That young engineer is smart and dedicated; he's definitely going places.
cards.exUz: Bu yosh muhandis aqlli va fidoyi, u albatta rivojlanadi.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyatga erishish, o'z sohasida oldinga siljish.

cards.ex: With your talent and dedication, the sky's the limit.
cards.exUz: Sizning iste'dodingiz va fidoyiligingiz bilan chegara yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Potentsial yoki imkoniyatlar deyarli cheksiz ekanligini ifodalash.

cards.ex: We need to develop a game plan to increase sales next quarter.
cards.exUz: Keyingi chorakda sotuvlarni oshirish uchun bizga reja kerak.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun tuzilgan batafsil reja.

cards.ex: The young athlete shows a lot of promise and could be a future champion.
cards.exUz: Yosh sportchi katta umid uyg'otmoqda va kelajakda chempion bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Katta muvaffaqiyatga erishish ehtimoli yuqori ekanligini ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: We left no avenue unexplored in our search for a solution to the problem.
cards.exUz: Muammoga yechim topish uchun biz barcha yo'llarni sinab ko'rdik.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilish yoki maqsadga erishish uchun barcha imkoniyatlarni ishga solmoq.

cards.ex: I'm not sure if I can fix it, but I'll have a go.
cards.exUz: Buni tuzata olishimga ishonchim komil emas, lekin men urinib ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qilishga harakat qilib ko'rmoq, sinab ko'rmoq.

cards.ex: She is a highly self-motivated employee who always gets the job done.
cards.exUz: U juda o'z-o'zini ruhlantiruvchi xodim, u har doim ishni bajaradi.
cards.uzDef: O'z-o'zidan harakat qilishga tayyor, boshqalarning yordamisiz harakat qila oladigan.

cards.ex: It's important to set ambitious goals to push yourself to achieve more.
cards.exUz: Ko'proq narsaga erishish uchun o'zingizni undash uchun katta maqsadlar qo'yish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Eriish qiyin bo'lgan, lekin muvaffaqiyatga olib keladigan maqsadlarni belgilamoq.

cards.ex: He's lost his get-up-and-go since he retired.
cards.exUz: U nafaqaga chiqqanidan beri energiyasini yo'qotdi.
cards.uzDef: Faol bo'lish, harakat qilish va ishlarni bajarish uchun zarur bo'lgan energiya va g'ayrat.

cards.ex: She always goes out of her way to help her colleagues.
cards.exUz: U har doim hamkasblariga yordam berish uchun jonini berib yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Kimdir uchun juda ko'p harakat qilmoq, o'z manfaatlarini chetga surib.

cards.ex: Having connections in the industry gave him a head start in his career.
cards.exUz: Sanoatda aloqalarga ega bo'lish unga o'z faoliyatida afzallik berdi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga nisbatan boshlashda afzallikka ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: The company reached a significant milestone with the launch of its new product.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yangi mahsulotining ishga tushirilishi bilan muhim bosqichga erishdi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim bir nuqtaga yetib kelmoq, muvaffaqiyatga erishmoq.

cards.ex: It's tough at first, but if you keep at it, you'll eventually succeed.
cards.exUz: Boshida qiyin, lekin davom ettirsangiz, oxir-oqibat muvaffaqiyatga erishasiz.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramasdan harakat qilishni davom ettirmoq.

cards.ex: Many young professionals aspire to leadership roles within their companies.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab yosh mutaxassislar o'z kompaniyalari ichida rahbarlik lavozimlariga intilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Rahbarlik lavozimini egallash, yetakchi bo'lishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: We must make every effort to reduce our carbon footprint.
cards.exUz: Biz uglerod izimizni kamaytirish uchun harakatni ayamaymiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan maqsadga erishish uchun barcha imkoniyatlarni ishga solmoq.

cards.ex: Her determination to succeed despite the challenges is truly inspiring.
cards.exUz: Uning qiyinchiliklarga qaramay muvaffaqiyatga erishish qat'iyati haqiqatan ham ilhomlantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun qattiq harakat qilmoq, to'xtamasdan harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: The coach set a high bar for the team, expecting them to win every game.
cards.exUz: Murabbiy jamoa uchun yuqori standart qo'ydi va ulardan har bir o'yinda g'alaba qozonishni kutdi.
cards.uzDef: O'ziga yoki boshqalarga nisbatan yuqori standartlarni belgilamoq.

cards.ex: Technology is a driving force behind economic growth.
cards.exUz: Texnologiya iqtisodiy o'sishning asosiy kuchidir.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir rivojlanishiga yoki muvaffaqiyatga erishishiga asosiy sababchi bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The kids were full of beans after their nap.
cards.exUz: Bolalar tushlikdan keyin energiya bilan to'lishdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ko'p energiya va g'ayratga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The new startup made a splash in the tech industry with its innovative product.
cards.exUz: Yangi startap o'zining innovatsion mahsuloti bilan texnologiya sanoatida ta'sir qildi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmaganda muvaffaqiyatga erishib, ko'pchilikning e'tiborini tortmoq.

cards.ex: Everyone needs to pull their weight if we want to finish this project on time.
cards.exUz: Agar biz ushbu loyihani o'z vaqtida tugatmoqchi bo'lsak, hamma o'z hissasini qo'shishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Jamoa a'zosi sifatida o'z vazifalarini bajarmoq, ishlashda adolatli bo'lmoq.
